section.hero.title: The SaaS foundation you cut down to what you actually use.
section.hero.description: Authentication, organisations, billing, emails: every module is switched on or off in one configuration line. What you leave out leaves no trace.
section.features.title: What the foundation saves you from writing
section.features.description: The three thousand lines every project rewrites, shipped with their tests and the reasoning behind them.
section.features.item.modules.title: Genuinely self-contained modules
section.features.item.modules.body: A module declares its schema, routes, navigation and translations. Disabling it removes them all, without a single condition inside a component.
section.features.item.toggle.title: A reversible CLI
section.features.item.toggle.body: Enable or disable a module at any point in the project's life. If anything fails, the configuration is restored.
section.features.item.compliance.title: Compliance and resilience by default
section.features.item.compliance.body: Rate limiting, data export, consent banner: part of the foundation, not of a paid add-on.

section.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
section.faq.description: What people ask before they start.
section.faq.item.stack.title: What is the technical stack?
section.faq.item.stack.body: Next.js, PostgreSQL with Drizzle, strict TypeScript. One stack, deliberately: there is no Prisma variant and no Vue variant.
section.faq.item.disable.title: What happens to a disabled module?
section.faq.item.disable.body: Its tables and data stay in place. Nothing is deleted: re-enabling it finds them intact, and no command exists to erase them.
section.faq.item.theme.title: Can I change the look?
section.faq.item.theme.body: The design system is neutral and themeable. Replacing the primary colour is enough to dress a project, dark theme included.

section.cta.description: Create an account, cut what you do not use, ship.

legal.privacy.section.data.body: Template to adapt before going live. Describe here the categories of data your service processes, the purpose of each processing activity and its legal basis. The categories declared by the enabled modules are a starting point, not an answer.
legal.privacy.section.retention.title: Retention period
legal.privacy.section.retention.body: Template to adapt. State how long each category is kept and what becomes of it afterwards: erasure or anonymisation. Every module declares its retention policy; this page must reflect it.
